technical_distinctions.current_capabilities: Willow below threshold memory test is not cryptographic quantum attack
technical_distinctions.mining: Grover theoretical query speedup does not equal practical SHA-256 ASIC advantage
technical_distinctions.Bitcoin: Shor threat affects elliptic-curve signatures, with distinct P2PKH/P2WPKH/P2TR exposure
technical_distinctions.NIST: FIPS 203 KEM differs from FIPS 204/205 signatures; 2035 timeline not Bitcoin activation
technical_distinctions.BIP360: Identified as proposal, not activated Bitcoin consensus
technical_distinctions.future: No unsupported guaranteed date for general-purpose cryptographically relevant fault-tolerant machine
